text:
ashley: Quick heads up — quant-smoke against new v2-int8 showed quality blur on multi-turn code completions. Proposing a compact golden refresh (150 samples) focused on code+context. Filing INF-2345 and a drive folder: https://redwood/drive/curation/quant-smoke
muzaffar: Can you paste the failing examples inline? want to check if these are true regressions or dupes from prod scrape
jia: Also: run fuzzy-fingerprint v2 at 0.85 first — we've seen label collisions look like regressions when dedupe wasn't applied
ashley: Pasting 6 quick failures below, full set in drive. Mostly missing continuation tokens and truncated arguments in generated code.
ashley: ```json
[
  {"input":"def add(a,b):\n  # user: how to call?","expected":"print(add(1,2)) -> 3"},
  {"input":"class Foo:\n  def __init__(self):","expected":"self.x = 0"}
]
```
labeler-bot: Queue status update: open label batches: 12, available labelers: 3, ETA throughput: ~18/hr
natalie: I can own the golden relabeling. Suggest splitting into 3 batches of 50 to parallelize. Do we need updated instructions for "code context" cases?
ashley: Yes — add a short instruction: preserve conversation turns and keep code fences as separate fields. Use schema: `{"input":"","context":"","expected":"","notes":""}`. Mark anything with prompt engineering hints as 'meta' in notes.
ryan: Important: freeze current golden set first (tag: gold-2026-07-01) and create eval job `evals/golden/quant-v2-smoke`. Run against fp32 baseline + int8 candidate. Schedule smoke run tomorrow 09:00 PT. If exact-match drop >5% we pause rollout.
muzaffar: I'll run dedupe now and upload cleaned CSV to gs://redwood-dev/curation/quant-smoke/1872509876/ before EOD. Using `fuzzy-fingerprint --threshold 0.85 --keep=diversity`
labeler-bot: Created batch: batch_id=gold-refresh-1872509876-1, items=50, assignee=natalie
natalie: Confirmed. Will start labeling after cleaned CSV is uploaded. Who does QC/second pass?
jia: I'll own QC second pass. Plan: 2-pass QC, 10% spot check, and a separate pass for edge-case multi-turn reasoning.
ashley: @jia awesome. @ryan will run the regression check after evals. If regression >5% on exact-match or >8% on semantic-score we rollback quant profile and open a model-team investigation.
muzaffar: Minor note: avoid sampling duplicates from our prod-scrape-2025 set; add `--exclude=prod-scrape-2025` to sampler. Use `--source=diverse-synth` to include edge cases.
jia: Also recommend adding a small adversarial subset (n=20) with obfuscated variable names — those catch subtle tokenizer-alignment bugs post-quant.
ashley: Quick operational question: any objections to locking these golden samples from further augmentation until the smoke is complete? :thinking:
muzaffar: No objections, +1
natalie: No objections from me
ryan: +1. Record freeze in changelog and link to rollout ticket INF-2350.
ashley: Great. I'll update INF-2345, tag gold-refresh-1872509876, create eval job, and post results here once done. Ping me if you see blockers. :shipit:
